name: B10-0223/2024 (ESN) – Continued repression of civil society and independent media in Azerbaijan and the cases of Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli, Kamran Mammadli, Rufat Safarov and Meydan TV
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continued repression of civil society and independent media in Azerbaijan and the cases of Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli, Kamran Mammadli, Rufat Safarov and Meydan TV
part_text:
This text is a motion for a resolution from a political group, not a law. It asks Azerbaijan to let prisoners see doctors and to free detained ethnic Armenians. It says the EU and Azerbaijan already talk about human rights in their partnership. It urges the EU to deepen ties with Azerbaijan and keep energy supply out of political debates. It also urges the EU to be careful about lecturing other countries on democracy and human rights.

- Nothing changes yet; Parliament has not voted on this text.
- It concerns Azerbaijan's authorities, prisoners, and EU-Azerbaijan relations.
- If adopted, it would be sent to EU institutions and member states as Parliament's position.
